book.title: Roma Roma Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Haḡai Sauꞌa moneo Rudaro, rehano Keriso teite Tiburanadu Ḡabodeꞌohe
Tena eme nagini reꞌuma? Badiꞌaꞌa manoḡa ragateragate furenifine, emeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa ꞌaune haḡae radiꞌumahe?
Mene hune! Emeꞌe haḡai sauꞌa moneo rudanadu haḡai sauꞌa mene bare haḡaiꞌuma. Nougenouge haḡai sauꞌa zamaḡano radiu onamogaꞌe idaḡa?
Emeḡe niduꞌaꞌe babatiso madu Keriso Iesu teite tiburaro zu emeꞌa babatiso madu ani teite rudaro. Zaꞌe eꞌe mene edeḡahe?
Emeꞌa babatiso madu Iesu teite rudaro ebu ani teite guriro. ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa Moga gigiꞌaḡa ḡihiꞌa hina rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodiroteꞌe teige, eme zuni ḡabone izigano radiꞌuma.
Eme aniꞌa rudaroteꞌe teige rudanadu ani teite tiburaro rae reine, aniꞌa bare ḡabodiroteꞌe teige, eme zuni bare ḡabodadu ane teite tiburaꞌuma.
Eme edeḡa, emeḡe ḡabone amahiḡaꞌe ani teite satauroneadu rudaro. Eꞌanoꞌo haḡai sauꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ahiꞌa ruinadu emeꞌe haḡai sauꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano mene bare reꞌuma.
Mazaḡa iniu haḡai sauꞌa moneo rudaroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo mae bohane buniro.
Emeꞌe Keriso teite rudaro rae reine, eme zuni ane teite ḡabodiꞌuma rae mae ḡihineꞌohe.
Eme edeḡa, Kerisoꞌe rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodiro ꞌahine, aniꞌe mene bare rudaꞌuma ebu runeꞌa mene bare zuhiꞌaniꞌuma.
Aniꞌa rudarotaꞌaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa inaraḡa varadifine ḡae tiba rudaro, ebu aniꞌa radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa veize radiuꞌohe.
Eꞌe teige, zae zuni zaeꞌa bare haḡai sauꞌa moneo rudanadu haḡai sauꞌa mene bare haḡaiteꞌe azaḡa ebu Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu Badiꞌa veize radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa rae edere huniꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo haḡai sauꞌaniꞌa ahirize rudatiteꞌe zuhiꞌanoga gararoꞌi. ꞌOugadu ahirize ura haḡaihi rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡa ago hegotoꞌi.

Zae ahiri hina haḡai sauꞌa ago haḡaoꞌi zu haḡai veꞌoḡa ago haḡaoꞌi. Ebu zaꞌe rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodiroteꞌe azaḡa radu ḡaboneze niduꞌa Badiꞌa hanoꞌi, zu Badiꞌa gau duduḡa veize ahirize niduꞌa ani hanoꞌi.
Zaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌenaꞌa mene radiuꞌohe, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa fureneꞌeteꞌe manoḡaḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano radiuꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo haḡai sauꞌaniꞌa zae zuhiꞌazoga mene hune idaraꞌuma.
Badiꞌa Ubumao Haḡai Duduḡa Haḡaeꞌeteꞌe Tuḡure Azaḡa
ꞌOugadu eme nougiꞌuma? Emeꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌenaꞌa, mene radiuꞌohe, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa fureneꞌeteꞌe manoḡaḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano radiuꞌohe. Eꞌe uꞌano, eme haḡai sauꞌa haḡaiꞌumahe? Mene hune!

Za zaeꞌa bare vaze ꞌahoga ꞌuꞌuḡano tuḡure vazeḡano rouga veize vaze eꞌe ḡoere hegotine, zaꞌe zaeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa eꞌe veize tuḡure vazeḡano reꞌuma. Za ꞌuguḡa aḡuꞌahe? Zaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa hegotadu haḡai sauꞌa tuḡure vazeḡano rudaꞌuma, ga Badiꞌa hegoteꞌenaꞌa ane tuḡure vazeḡa radu ane ubumao duduḡa rae reꞌuma.
Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi rae raꞌohe, mazaḡa ibite zaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano reiro, rehano izidi za zaeꞌa meiroteꞌe ihoreḡa huga zamaze niduꞌa hina hegoteꞌohe.
Ebu zaꞌe haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo bohaze buziro, ebu Badiꞌa ubumao haḡai duduḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano reiro.

Eḡe ḡoere hugaꞌe zaeꞌa mene faine zamareꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, e vazeꞌa raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano ziꞌohe. Ibite zaeꞌa ahirize rana toraga zu sauꞌa mae vidanadu eꞌe hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano reiro, zu haḡai sauꞌa ufeta ragate haḡairo. Rehano izidi zaeꞌa ahirize Badiꞌa hanadu ane ubumao haḡai duduḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano roꞌi, ebu ḡabone zaḡoḡano radoꞌi.
Zaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano reirotene, Badiꞌa ubumao haḡai duduḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe moneo mene zamareꞌenaꞌa radiunu.
Radone ꞌuguḡanonoꞌo za nagi huga hidiro? Zaꞌa ibite ꞌouge radiroteꞌe moneo izidi mazagarozeꞌe rehano, ꞌuguḡa radoneḡa hugaꞌe rune.
Rehano izidi zaꞌe haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo bohazadu Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano reiro, zu ḡabonezeꞌa huga fureranadu ḡabone zaḡoḡa zamaḡano radiuꞌohe. ꞌOuge radiuꞌeteꞌe hugaꞌe ḡabone tuḡutuḡu.
Haḡai sauꞌa naeḡaꞌe rune, rehano Badiꞌa ḡahunoneꞌe emeꞌa Zuhiꞌa Boro Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu hideꞌeteꞌe ḡaboneḡa tuḡutuḡu.
